A small fix for the panel window on Windows. If you installed Daybook with the installer, the app offers this update by itself. Restart Daybook, or press **Settings → Updates → Check for updates**, to see it straight away.

## Fixed

- **The panel window could not be moved.** It has no visible title bar, and the strip at the top that should have held the window was switched off by mistake. You can now drag the window by the top edge, or by the greeting and the clock under it. Nothing new is shown: they look exactly as before. The buttons there still work as buttons.

## Downloading

- **Windows:** `Daybook-Setup-1.4.3.exe` (installs, and updates itself) or `Daybook-1.4.3-portable.exe` (runs without installing). Windows will say *"Windows protected your PC"*. Press **More info → Run anyway**.
- **Mac:** `Daybook-1.4.3-mac.dmg`. The first time, macOS refuses to open it. Go to **System Settings → Privacy & Security** and press **Open Anyway** next to Daybook.

Both warnings are about the missing paid signing certificates, not about the program. The source is all in this repository if you would rather build it yourself.
